authority_rules.design_intent: The external Page boards govern adopted design intent, grouping, composition, and visual direction.
authority_rules.implementation_fact: Current source and generated contracts govern what is actually coded, produced, reachable, and wired.
authority_rules.status_reporting: The composition inventory records adoption and D/C/P/R/A/F/B/V independently; no single implemented boolean is allowed.
authority_rules.local_qa: Local visual QA may use HOME_SURFACES_CANON_DIR only after every configured file hash verifies.
authority_rules.ci: CI validates this record, the inventory, application fixtures, and app-capture evidence without requiring a personal Downloads directory.

adoption_vocabulary.adopted: Approved product direction; implementation evidence is still tracked separately.
adoption_vocabulary.exploratory: Design study, not an implementation commitment.
adoption_vocabulary.relocated: The need is real but another surface owns the composition.
adoption_vocabulary.rejected: Explicitly not part of the intended product direction.
adoption_vocabulary.unresolved: Requires a recorded product/design decision before feature implementation.

evidence_vocabulary.D: Designed in the canonical Page board.
evidence_vocabulary.C: A component or render branch exists.
evidence_vocabulary.P: A grounded backend or local producer exists.
evidence_vocabulary.R: The real projection can deliver the payload to the component.
evidence_vocabulary.A: Navigation, mutation, dismissal, and error lifecycle are wired.
evidence_vocabulary.F: A deterministic application fixture was reviewed against this exact design authority.
evidence_vocabulary.V: Observed and accepted on a supported physical device/platform.

evidence_states.verified: The cited static or executed evidence establishes this level for the named composition.
evidence_states.partial: Some substrate or variants meet the level, but the composition does not meet it end to end.
evidence_states.not_verified: No evidence in the audit establishes this level.
evidence_states.not_applicable: The level is intentionally inapplicable to this composition.

evidence_receipt_contract.source_policy: Sources must be workspace-relative durable artifacts; canonical design exports remain external and must not be copied into the repository.

completion_rule: No user-visible composition is complete, shipped, certified, or accepted without naming the evidence layer. V=verified requires a physical-device receipt and is not established by this authority record or the static audit.
